howto: You run on your own. Your battery drains every second.
Tap (or Space) to hop the pink zapper spikes; swipe down (or hold Down) to slide under the orange conduits.
Grab the green battery cells: each one is +12 volts. At zero volts the lights go out.
tips: A hit costs 26 volts, two whole cells: dodging matters more than collecting.
Dash (Shift or swipe right) costs 22 volts but smashes straight through a hazard.
Cells float at three heights: hop early to catch the high ones.
Every sector the run gets faster and the drain gets stronger, so bank cells early.

controls.keyboard: Space, W or Up to hop; S or Down to slide; Shift or X to dash; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap to hop, swipe down to slide, swipe right to dash; the pause button sits bottom right

difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 11 to 24 and the battery drain from 4 to 15 volts a second over the first 900 m, through five sectors.

cheats.effect: Battery never drains and hits cost nothing
Battery cells fly to you from any height

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start a run
features.instant-restart: Run again on the Blackout screen, or Space; Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best on the title card and a live Best cell in the HUD (starred when you pass it)
features.tutorial-card: Two skippable coach cards on the first run (hop and slide, then dash); Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Blackout screen with score, distance, cells, dashes, hits and all-time best
